title: Art of War
description: If you do not play any Attacks during your turn, gain an additional 1 energy next turn.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Tracks whether any Attack cards were played during the current turn. At the start of the next turn, if no Attacks were played in the previous turn (and turn number > 1), grants 1 energy and flashes the relic. Resets tracking state after combat ends.
